_doc: Expected shortcut renderer output, indexed by profile id. Both the JS resolver (desktop/shared/spa/js/fixture_shortcuts.js) and the Kotlin twin (android/.../FixtureShortcuts.kt) must produce these exact `id` lists in this exact order for the corresponding profile. tests/test_fixture_shortcuts.py exercises the JS path via Node. The Android JUnit test (when added) exercises the Kotlin path against the same JSON corpus.
